# Run prediction workflow

Start by configuring our R environment and loading the package locally:

```{r}
#| include: false
# configure R environment
setwd('~/dev/dawson2021-httkqspr')
source('.Rprofile')
base::readRenviron(".Renviron")
devtools::load_all('httkqsprs', export_all = FALSE)
```

Now, let's try to develop!

```{r}
chem.ids <- c("CICHEM010017986", "CICHEM000200048", "CICHEM000200014")
result <- httkqsprs::generate_preds(
  "zzz",
  chems = chem.ids,
  conn_str = Sys.getenv("PIPELINES_CONN_STR")
)
```

```{r}
colnames(result$Clint)
```

Now save to a file
```{r}
result$Clint |>
  dplyr::select(
    cichem = MoleculeID,
    ClintPredictBin,
    ClintPredictBin_MD,
    ClintPredictBin_SD,
    SImin,
    SImax,
    SImean,
    SIsd,
    SI90,
    Outlier
  )
```
